name: clinic
description: Patients in SQLite, doctors' working hours, appointment booking and cancellation, insurance coverage and invoices for a small clinic.
author: test-split author (Claude Opus 5.5 agent)

issues.description: The docstring says only a booked appointment can be cancelled, but only COMPLETED is refused: an already cancelled or no-show appointment can be cancelled again, and a second late cancellation charges the fee twice.
issues.fix_hint: Raise ValueError whenever the status is not AppointmentStatus.BOOKED.

issues.description: timedelta.seconds is only the seconds part and ignores whole days, so a cancellation three days and two hours ahead counts as two hours of notice and is charged as late.
issues.fix_hint: Compare the whole timedelta: start - now < timedelta(hours=LATE_CANCELLATION_NOTICE_HOURS), or use total_seconds().

issues.description: coverage_split returns (patient_share, insurer_share) but the result is unpacked the other way round, so with 80% coverage the patient is billed 80% and the insurer 20%.
The search text typed at the reception is formatted into the SQL string, so a quote in it changes the query (for example ' OR '1'='1 returns every patient).
issues.fix_hint: Use a bound parameter: WHERE name LIKE ? with the value f"%{name_part}%".

issues.anchor: if start < opens or end > closes:
issues.description: The working-hours rule lives in availability.within_working_hours, but Schedule.book re-implements it inline instead of calling it, so the two copies can drift apart.
render_invoice is a 60-line function that builds every section of the printout (header, patient, visit, amounts, payment note) and repeats the label/amount alignment three times.
The private helper _money is never called; render_invoice formats amounts inline instead.

decoys.anchor: f"WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) ORDER BY id"
decoys.why_it_is_fine: The f-string only inserts one '?' per id; the ids themselves are passed as bound parameters.
The broad except logs, rolls the transaction back and re-raises, so nothing is swallowed.
